warnings: Axis reads 1..8 at 3.60 m then jumps to 11, with no grid ⑨ and no ⑩ -- the same as A-04 and the structural sheets, and against A-03. Third independent confirmation of the axis decision recorded on หน้า00_gridline.json.

MATERIAL CONFLICT with A-02. This sheet labels the roof 'หลังคากระเบื้องลูกฟูกลอนเล็ก สีขาว' (WHITE) in both slope callouts, while A-02's รายการประกอบแบบ item 2.3.ง specifies 'กระเบื้องลูกฟูกลอนเล็ก สีซีเมนต์' (CEMENT colour). Profile agrees, colour does not. Both are recorded as printed on their own sheets; neither was overwritten. A-02 also states materials may be varied to suit the client ('วัสดุต่างๆดังกล่าวข้างต้น สามารถเปลี่ยนแปลงได้ตามความเหมาะสม'), which likely explains the difference.

The roof is a plain symmetric gable: ridge along grid ข, two slopes to ค and ก, 1.20 m eaves. No hips, valleys, dormers or roof penetrations are drawn, and no gutters or downpipes appear on this sheet (A-03's หมายเหตุ defers drainage to site conditions).

No pitch value is printed here -- only SLOPE direction arrows. The 25-degree pitch comes from S-07's T1 truss elevation (หน้า20) and is NOT repeated on this sheet, so it is not restated in these elements.
Section callouts 1/A-07 and 2/A-07 and the four-way elevation rose to 1-4/A-06 appear here exactly as on A-04.
